device_entry.description: 一款可编程多轴机械臂，可按G代码或预定义路径执行运动任务。在实验室中常用于自动化取放、样品转运、定位与重复轨迹操作等流程。
device_entry.description_en: A programmable multi-axis robotic arm that can execute motion tasks from G-code or predefined paths. In laboratories, it is commonly used for automated pick-and-place, sample transfer, positioning, and repeatable motion workflows.
